assumptions.WI-AQ-012: QueueReferences binds ancestry to a recovered same-store session. Foreign claims encode only external_ref. AQ owns child inheritance and permits only CausalOverride fields. References never authorize reads.
assumptions.WI-AQ-015: TaskInputLocator version 1 encodes a scoped artifact in task bytes. ExternalDataRef is used separately at output APIs. Runtime authorizes before ContextStore integrity/read. Bundle backup retains WI/AQ offline locks and validates artifact closure.
assumptions.WI-AQ-001: Production binding persists the complete EnsureTaskRequest with a preallocated task UUID. High-level ensure_task computes CanonicalAdmissionV2.
assumptions.WI-AQ-002: The same persisted key/request retries after uncertain acknowledgment. Changed in-scope digest-bearing fields conflict; a changed tenant ID is rejected by AQ host scope before conflict lookup, preserving the admitted task and projection (operator-approved AB-WI-003 interpretation).
assumptions.WI-AQ-004: AQ task acknowledgment closes delivery. Authorized paginated inspection discovers run mappings separately.

wi/WI-03/integration.mapping: Observation admission atomically journals each delivery's complete EnsureTaskRequest::for_task. RecoverQueue journals a replacement task request before AQ admission. The task/{TaskId} key and all request bytes are immutable within a generation; uncertain acknowledgments retry the saved bytes. Created and AlreadyExists must return the request's task ID, key, canonical version/digest and a nonzero durable sequence before WI records task_admitted. AQ conflicts propagate without local completion.
wi/WI-03/integration.review: Candidate tests are implementation evidence; independent G2/G3 and assigned-case attestations remain controller-managed. The primary scope and AB-WI-003 interpretation above remain owned by WI-04/integration.

AB-WI-003.pass_criterion: Using the public CanonicalAdmissionV2 vectors, change each valid digest-bearing field. Require a same-key AQ conflict for every in-scope mutation. A changed tenant ID must receive AQ host scope rejection before conflict lookup. Both outcomes preserve the admitted task and projection. Do not supply an independent digest to high-level ensure_task.

later_owners: G3 wake/signal adapters and G4 executor/continuation integration retain their mapped owners.
